algorithm: SHA-256 Merkle tree over per-box salted leaves
leaf_format: sha256(0x00 || canonical_json({box_id, contents, salt})), salt = HMAC-SHA256(allocation_seed, 'wiznerdz-leaf-salt-v1:' + box_id)
node_format: sha256(0x01 || left || right); odd node promoted unchanged

supersedes.algorithm: v1 — single SHA-256 over the whole private payload
supersedes.reason: Two problems. (1) Proving any single box's contents required disclosing every box's contents. (2) The allocation seed was a human-readable pattern ('wiznerdz-mint-prod-YYYY-MM-DD-vN'); it was recovered from published data in 0.02 seconds and regenerated all 4438 boxes exactly, so the sealed contents were derivable by anyone. No sales had occurred.

supersedes.algorithm: v2 Merkle — over the allocation generated from the weak seed
supersedes.reason: Computed locally but never published. It committed to the same compromised allocation, and additionally published sha256(weak_seed) in its header, which made seed recovery a direct 3720-hash enumeration.

allocation_note: Regenerated 2026-08-12 from a 256-bit CSPRNG seed held outside the repository. Box contents differ from all superseded allocations. No sale had occurred at any point during these replacements.
